reviewText: Finally, a rummy app that doesn't lag! The card sorting is so smooth and the interface feels really premium. Best way to kill time during my commute.
Bohot sahi game hai. Private table feature use karke cousins ke saath roz khelte hain. Graphics are clean and easy to understand.
The matchmaking is lightning fast, never have to wait to start a hand. Would love to see more tournament themes in future updates though.
App runs perfectly on my phone without any heating issues. Daily missions are a nice touch to keep the practice sessions interesting.
Matchmaking fast hai, par graphics thoda aur optimize ho sakte hain. Kabhi kabhi animations hang ho jaate hain device pe.
